And many more

Proprietary technologies

Pantheon

GPU task balancing

Pantheon runs AI inference for our products, autoscales compute, and distributes inference across GPUs with minimal overhead.

Alt-Spooner

Personal AI agent

Alt-Spooner handles a Spooner’s day-to-day tasks, with context, memory, integrations, and permissions isolated to its owner.

AI SRE

Infrastructure monitoring and intervention

AI SRE responds to production incidents in real time, diagnosing root causes, alerting the team, and executing safe remediations.

Minerva

User lifetime value predictions

Minerva leverages AI to update its predictions in real time, provide critical inputs to other internal systems, and inform decision-making.

Juno

Payment management

Juno supports checkout flows, subscriptions, price changes, promotional codes, billing retries, invoicing, and experimentation.

Xina

Marketing attribution

Xina matches installs to the marketing interactions that drove them, attributes conversions across ad networks, and informs campaign decisions.

Galf

Access management

Galf grants time-boxed permissions on cloud resources, automates in-scope approvals, and routes cross-scope requests to designated approvers.

Pico

Data ingestion

Pico validates client events against registered schemas, enriches them with context, routes them for analysis, and enforces privacy standards.
